title: eval-harness: add per-prompt CI hook for prompt-regression gating
description:
Motivation: Teams running model rollouts need deterministic, per-prompt regression checks gated in CI to catch localized quality drops before rollout. This PR introduces a lightweight, configurable per-prompt CI hook that runs the eval-harness prompt-set against candidate model artifacts and fails the job when configured thresholds regress.

Summary of changes: adds a new CI hook (eval-harness/ci/hooks/per_prompt_ci_hook.py), a small integration shim for GitHub Actions, documentation for configuring prompt-level gates, and tests covering threshold behavior and logging. The hook supports: per-prompt thresholds, global fallback thresholds, optional sample-size limits, and a metrics payload submitted to our eval-metrics ingestion endpoint for traceability.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implementation of CI hook and CLI wrapper
- [x] Unit tests for threshold logic and edge cases
- [x] Integration example GitHub Actions workflow and docs
- [x] Metrics emission + structured payload for downstream dashboards
- [x] Backwards-compatible defaults (no gating unless project opts in)

Why not change existing CI? The approach is intentionally opt-in and separate from current per-commit unit/integration checks: rollouts often require model-level evals which are expensive and run at different cadence. This hook can be scheduled or attached to release workflows.

Related: ENG-2974, previous eval-harness gating work (see PRs: 312459, 400123 for metrics integration history).

review_conversation:
Jordan Brooks (2026-01-21): Can you clarify the failure semantics for partial regressions (some prompts worse, others better)? Author (Priya Nair): Hook currently fails the job when any prompt crosses its specified threshold; we'll add an argument to allow an aggregate-mode (percentile / aggregate delta) in follow-ups.
Miguel Alvarez (2026-01-22): Please add tests for low-sample-size behavior (n<5) so results aren't noisy. Author (Priya Nair): Added unit tests to return 'skipped' for samples below configurable min_samples; default is 5.
Evelyn Park (2026-01-28): Can we emit a deterministic metrics payload that includes prompt_id, baseline_model, candidate_model, metric_name, value, delta? I want to wire this into dashboards. Author (Priya Nair): Added structured JSON payload to eval-metrics client and included sample in docs.
CI (2026-02-02): Unit tests failed due to a lint/flake; fix pushed and tests re-run — all checks green. Miguel Alvarez (2026-02-03): lgtm, approved. Jordan Brooks (2026-02-03): approved and requesting squash merge.
release_notes: Adds an opt-in per-prompt CI hook for the eval-harness that enables prompt-level regression gates. Includes documentation and example GitHub Actions workflow. Defaults to no gating unless configured.
